articles.title_en: Cannafest takes place during first year home cannabis cultivation is legal in Czechia
articles.lead_en: Czechia’s annual trade show for cannabis, Cannafest, took place on the first weekend of November at the PVA exposition center in Letňany, Prague. With none other than the first lady of the Czech Republic, Eva Pavlová, as patron, the exhibition brought together experts from law to medicine, and enthusiasts alike, to enjoy goodies from vendors, live music and public debates regarding cannabis.

articles.title_en: Dárek sobě na celý rok. iDNES Premium je na Singles’ Day za 490 Kč, levnější nebude
